| [**Fault Tolerance**](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/user-guides/fault-tolerance/request-migration) | Canary health checks + in-flight request migration | Workers fail; user requests don't |

### New in 1.0

- **Zero-config deploy ([DGDR](https://docs.nvidia.com/dynamo/kubernetes-deployment/deploy-models/dgdr-reference))** *(beta):* Specify model, HW, and SLA in one YAML — AIConfigurator auto-profiles the workload, Planner optimizes the topology, and Dynamo deploys
- **Agentic inference:** Per-request hints for priority, expected output length, and speculative prefill, plus session metadata for tracing and SGLang subagent KV isolation. [LangChain](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/integrations/chat/nvidia_ai_endpoints#use-with-nvidia-dynamo) + [NeMo Agent Toolkit](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Agent-Toolkit) integrations
- **Multimodal E/P/D:** Disaggregated encode/prefill/decode with embedding cache — 30% faster TTFT on image workloads
- **Video generation:** Native [FastVideo](https://github.com/hao-ai-lab/FastVideo) + [SGLang Diffusion](https://lmsys.org/blog/2026-02-16-sglang-diffusion-advanced-optimizations/) support — real-time 1080p on single B200
- **K8s Inference Gateway plugin:** KV-aware routing inside the standard Kubernetes gateway
- **Storage-tier KV offload:** S3/Azure blob support + global KV events for cluster-wide cache visibility

## Request Routing Topologies

Dynamo can expose traffic through two Kubernetes request routing topologies. Both expose an
OpenAI-compatible API and support the same backends, disaggregated serving, and KV-aware routing.

| Topology | What it is | When to use |
|------|------------|-------------|
| **Dynamo-native Frontend routing** | The Dynamo Frontend serves HTTP and the integrated Dynamo Router makes worker-selection decisions. No external gateway is required. | Local development, single-cluster deployments, and environments where Dynamo should own the request entry point end to end. |
| **Gateway API routing with GAIE** | A Kubernetes [Gateway API Inference Extension](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api-inference-extension) gateway calls the Dynamo Endpoint Picker Plugin (EPP) before forwarding to the selected worker's Frontend sidecar in `--router-mode direct`. | Kubernetes platforms that standardize on Gateway API, or deployments where gateway-level policy, auth, rate limiting, and observability should sit at the cluster edge. |

Request flow for the Dynamo-native path is `client → Frontend → Router → workers`. Request flow for
the Gateway API path is `client → Gateway → EPP → Frontend sidecar (direct) → workers`.

See the [Gateway API Inference Extension (GAIE) guide](docs/fern/pages/kubernetes/kv-aware-routing/gateway-api.mdx) for
the Gateway API setup, supported features, and configuration.

> This repo ships agent skills: if you work with an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex,
> Cursor), clone the repo and ask it to deploy, troubleshoot, benchmark, or optimize a Dynamo
> deployment. The skills activate automatically; no setup required.

### Option A: Container (fastest)

```bash
# Pull a prebuilt container (SGLang example)
docker run --gpus all --network host --rm -it nvcr.io/nvidia/ai-dynamo/sglang-runtime:1.4.1
```

the Gateway API path is `client → Gateway → EPP → Frontend sidecar (direct) → workers`.

data.head: 2c4ab6cf9aae89b54286196c8d6c576c715e2f45
data.rationale: Dynamo 是 Rust 核心 + Python 扩展层 + Kubernetes 部署层的三层大型仓库，学习路线按『先跑通、再读运行时、后攻高级机制』设计：U1-U2 让读者零基础跑起 hello world 并理解仓库分层；U3-U5 沿一条请求的真实路径（DistributedRuntime → lib/llm HttpService → Python frontend）讲核心调用链；U6-U8 覆盖 Dynamo 的招牌能力——KV 感知路由、P/D 分离式服务与三大引擎后端接入；U9-U12 进入专家层：KVBM 多层 KV 缓存、K8s Operator 与 DGD、Planner 自动扩缩，最后以可观测、测试与容错收尾。每篇讲义只讲一个主题、引用真实存在的源码文件，并给出可操作的代码实践（优先用 mocker 和 sample 后端，避免读者必须有 GPU）。

解释 PushWorkHandler 的推送语义
说出 ingress.rs/egress.rs/push_router 各自的职责

learning_goals: 解释 etcd lease 如何实现 worker 存活检测

lectures.title: HttpService：OpenAI 兼容 HTTP 服务
lectures.topic: service_v2.rs 的 HttpService/HttpServiceConfig/State 与 InflightPermit 并发控制，openai.rs/generate.rs 处理 OpenAI 兼容端点与流式生成。

lectures.title: Worker 类型与服务发现：discovery 模块
lectures.topic: 引擎如何知道有哪些 worker：worker_type.rs 区分 prefill/decode/both 等角色，discovery/model.rs 的 Model 与 WorkerTypeReadiness 管理就绪状态，worker_set.rs/model_manager.rs 维护动态 worker 集合。

lectures.title: 请求整形：prepost.py 与流式后处理
lectures.topic: 前端最厚的文件 prepost.py：PreprocessResult、preprocess_chat_request 的请求整形与 StreamingPostProcessor 的 token 流后处理（工具调用解析、reasoning 提取）。

为自定义后端实现一个 processor

lectures.title: 后端差异化 Processor
lectures.topic: 不同后端对请求/响应的特化处理：vllm_processor.py 的 VllmProcessor（含多模态路由）、sglang_processor.py/sglang_prepost.py 的 SGLang 侧逻辑，以及它们如何挂进 EngineFactory。

lectures.title: 路由概览与 Python 入口：dynamo.router

解释 batching/state_agent 对事件洪峰的缓解
说出 KvEvent 线格式中的关键字段

lectures.title: KV 事件流：publisher 与 ZMQ 线格式
lectures.topic: 路由的情报来源：各 worker 通过 publisher 发布 KV 事件（event_processor.rs 处理、batching.rs 合并、zmq_listener.rs 订阅），zmq_wire/types.rs 定义 KvEvent 线格式。

learning_goals: 解释 radix tree 如何索引各 worker 的 KV 前缀
实现一次 KV 重合度查询
说出 cuckoo 索引与 approximate_lru 的适用场景
lectures.practice_task: 写一个 Rust 单元测试：向 radix_tree 插入两个 worker 的相同前缀与不同后缀，验证 lookup 返回的重合块数符合手工计算。
lectures.title: 基数树与 KV 索引：找到缓存的 worker
lectures.topic: KV 感知的核心数据结构：radix_tree.rs/concurrent_radix_tree.rs 的压缩基数树记录『哪些前缀缓存在哪个 worker』，配合 kv_indexer.rs、cuckoo 布谷鸟索引与 approximate_lru 完成重合度查找。

learning_goals: 解释 filter-score-pick 三段式策略模型
向 WorkerSelectionPolicyRegistry 注册自定义策略
打包并用 custom-policy example 验证插件加载

定位 prefill 与 decode 之间传递 KV 的组件

lectures.title: P/D 分离：概念与最小 disagg 拓扑
lectures.topic: 分离式服务入门：为什么要把 prefill 与 decode 拆成独立 GPU 池，sample 后端 disagg.sh 如何编排两类 worker，KV 在两池之间如何移交。

描述 conditional_disagg 的切换条件

lectures.title: Prefill 路由与条件分离
lectures.topic: 请求该进哪个池：prefill_router/mod.rs 的预填充路由器、activation.rs 的激活条件、admission.rs 的准入控制，以及 kv-router 的 conditional_disagg.rs（按负载/请求特征在聚合与分离间切换）。

定位一次 KV 传输在源码中的触发点

lectures.title: KV 传输引擎：NIXL / NCCL / memcpy
lectures.topic: P/D 之间真正的数据搬运：block/transfer/ 下的 nixl.rs（RDMA/NVLink 高速传输）、nccl.rs、memcpy.rs 多种传输后端及其选择逻辑。
